title: Surcharge and cess on TDS (Finance Act)
description: The surcharge on tax deducted at source from payments to non-residents, under section 3(7) of the Finance Act, 2026 for the entries of the Income-tax Act, 2025 deducted at the rates those entries specify and under Part II of its First Schedule for the entries deducted at the rates in force, by payee and by the income or aggregate of incomes subject to the deduction; and the Health and Education Cess of 4% that section 3(16) adds to the tax and surcharge, which section 3(17)(i) does not add where the income is paid to a domestic company and any other person who is resident in India. The rows apply from 1 April 2026; the Finance Act, 2026 gives effect to the proposals for the financial year 2026-27, so they end on 31 March 2027 and the set holds none after that day until the next Finance Act is added.

cells.appliesTo: sub-sections (6) to (14)
cells.words: (16) The amount of income-tax as specified in sub-sections (6) to (14) and as increased by the applicable surcharge, for the purposes of the Union, calculated in the manner provided therein, shall be further increased by an additional surcharge, for the purposes of the Union, to be called the “Health and Education Cess on income-tax”, calculated at the rate of 4% of such income-tax and surcharge so as to fulfil the commitment of the Government to provide and finance quality health services and universalised quality basic education and secondary and higher education.
